title: Feature Request: Move the "Add Event" (+) button to the bottom for one-handed use
body:
Apple Calendar has the most user-friendly interface I’ve ever used. However, having the "Add Event" (+) button at the very top of the screen makes one-handed operation incredibly difficult on modern, larger iPhones.

Interestingly, Apple has already updated Mail, Contacts, Messages, and Notes to feature primary action buttons at the bottom of the screen. The Calendar app's lower toolbar currently has plenty of empty space that could easily accommodate both the + (Add) and Search buttons. Bringing this design language to Calendar would greatly improve accessibility and reachability.
author: Firas Sahawneh

title: Feedback on Calendar & Reminders Integration – Timed Reminder Display Issue
body:
Dear Apple Team,

I have been a dedicated user of the Calendar and Reminders apps for more than five years, and I genuinely appreciate how thoughtfully these tools are designed. They have become core parts of my daily productivity system, and the recent integration of Reminders directly into the Calendar app is a feature I was very pleased to see. It has made planning and task management much more seamless.

However, I have recently noticed a recurring issue that I hope your team can look into. When creating a reminder with a specific time in the Reminders app, there are occasions where—due to what appears to be a technical glitch—the same task shows up as an “All Day” item in the Calendar instead of appearing at the designated time. This can sometimes create confusion in scheduling and time management.

Aside from this issue, the experience with both apps has been excellent, and I truly value the reliability and simplicity that Apple products offer. I hope this feedback helps improve an already outstanding ecosystem.

Thank you for your continued efforts in making such powerful and elegant productivity tools.

Best regards,
Asif Jamshed
